summary.zh: 定位、增长模式与渠道预算分配
summary.en: Marketing leadership for positioning, growth model and budget

description.zh: 面向营销负责人，处理定位、产品驱动与销售驱动及社区驱动的增长选择、渠道预算分配和营销团队搭建。适合增长停滞，或不确定该把预算和人放在哪个渠道的时候。
description.en: Marketing leadership work: positioning, choosing between product-led, sales-led and community-led growth, splitting budget across channels, and designing the team. Fits a growth plateau or a stuck budget call.
